$comment: The framework's Evaluator Registry (see docs/PRD-framework.md §Evaluator Registry, §4 Data Contracts). This is the curated, calibration-tracked list that L1/L2 bind DesignSpec objectives against — distinct from registry/tamarind_catalog.json, which is just a raw sync of what Tamarind exposes. An entry here with status 'needs_calibration' may run but MAY NOT rank candidates (PRD-framework.md §6).

evaluators.notes: Candidate for c_fold_conf (PRD.md §6.3). Verify current schema/name via GET /tools before use — do not assume field names.
Faster than alphafold; PRD.md names this tool explicitly for c_fold_conf. Cross-check against Proto's ESMFold path — pick one source of truth, don't run both silently.
Candidate proxy for c_cooperativity / thermal stability shift, NOT a direct Tm predictor. Must be benchmarked against the Piraner held-out set (PRD.md §7.2) before it can inform c_tm_target.
Secondary developability check, not in PRD.md's constraint set as written. Add only if the team decides expressibility risk needs a second signal.
